quarterly_data.quarter: Dell press release: Dell Technologies Introduces XPS Googlebook: The First XPS (09-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Dell announced the XPS Googlebook, a 13-inch premium laptop powered by the Snapdragon X Elite processor, which Dell calls the first XPS device designed for Gemini Intelligence (Google's Googlebook platform): up to 32GB of LPDDR5X memory and an NPU, a 2.5K InfinityEdge touch display (100% DCI-P3 color coverage, 500 nits, 30Hz to 120Hz variable refresh rate), an aluminum chassis at 2.2lbs and 12.7mm thin, and up to 16 hours of Netflix streaming on a single charge. US pricing starts at $999; it is available on Best Buy and Google Stores 'today' (release dated September 21, 2026) and on Dell.com in October.
quarterly_data.figure: starting at $999; up to 32GB LPDDR5X; up to 16 hours battery; Best Buy and Google Stores at launch, Dell.com in October
